cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run
def size(pairs): return sum(len(a)+len(b)+32 for a,b in pairs)
fields = [[":method","POST"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/big"]]
i = 0
while True:
    cand = fields + [["x-list-f%03d" % i, "v%d" % i]]
    if size(cand) > 8192: break
    fields = cand; i += 1
print('initial pairs', len(fields), 'size', size(fields))
tr = []
j = 0
while True:
    cand = tr + [["x-audit-%d" % j, "t"]]
    if size(cand) > 8192: break
    tr = cand; j += 1
print('trailer pairs', len(tr), 'size', size(tr))
ev = [{"sid":0,"type":"headers","fields":fields},
      {"sid":0,"type":"data","hex":"00"*10},
      {"sid":0,"type":"headers","fields":tr},
      {"sid":0,"type":"fin"}]
r = run({"routes":{"https://demo.test":"o"},"events":ev})
rec = r['streams'][0]
print(rec['status'], rec['length'])
raw = bytes.fromhex(r['origins']['o'])
lines = raw.split(b'\r\n')
print(lines[0]); print(lines[1]); print(lines[2]); print(lines[3][:50], '...')
print('tail', lines[-6:])
tr_line = [l for l in lines if l.startswith(b'trailer: ')][0]
print('announcement count', len(tr_line.split(b': ',1)[1].split(b', ')))
assert rec['status'] == 'forwarded'
# verify one chunk of 10 bytes
assert b'\r\n\r\na\r\n' + b'\x00'*10 + b'\r\n0\r\n' in raw
print('chunk framing ok')
EOF
